```yaml
name: Upgrade Check & Visual Parity

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint-and-validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Prettier Lint
        run: npm run lint:prettier

      - name: Run Style Contract Lint
        run: npm run lint:style-contract

  integration-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Setup Python (Optional Helper)
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install Python Dependencies (if bin/setup-python-deps exists)
        run: |
          if [ -f "bin/setup-python-deps" ]; then
            chmod +x bin/setup-python-deps
            ./bin/setup-python-deps
          fi

      - name: Run Bootstrap Compat Integration Test
        run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

      - name: Run Distill Integration Test
        run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

      - name: Run Upgrade CLI Integration Test
        run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh

  shell-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run ShellCheck
        uses: luizm/action-sh-checker@883217215b11c1fabbf00eb1a9a041f62d74c744
        env:
          SHFMT_OPTS: "-d"
          SHCHECK_OPTS: "-x"
        with:
          sh_checker_exclude: "vendor|node_modules"
          sh_checker_shfmt_disable: "false"
          sh_checker_shellcheck_disable: "false"
          sh_checker_checkbashisms_enable: "true"
          sh_checker_comment: "true"
          sh_checker_only_diff: "false"

  notify:
    needs: [lint-and-validate, integration-tests, shell-check]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
```
